name: Definitions
rules: Definition identity is qualified by kindId + definitionId.
DefinitionId does not need to be globally unique across kinds.
DefinitionSet validates all entries before successful construction.
Validator IDs and definition IDs must be unique within their scopes.
GameDefinitions is immutable after construction and rejects duplicate kinds.
Public ordered ID lists are precomputed and reused.
Definitions never execute gameplay or mutate runtime aggregates.
Stage 61 semantic classification subsystem is not anticipated.
